office_does: Hears and decides misdemeanor cases for the City of Seattle for a four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: civil attorney and pro tem judge Shantrice Anderson is the only candidate; no sitting judge is on the ballot for this seat.

candidates.summary: Civil attorney and Seattle Municipal Court pro tem judge with more than a decade of prior public defense work in King County and Colorado; not a sitting judge.
highlights: Pro Tem Judge/Magistrate in Seattle Municipal Court; current civil practice [S1]
More than a decade as a public defender in King County and Colorado [S1]
Endorsed by retiring Judge Faye Chess, among others [S1]
